fields.title: Reader shortcodes: plugin shortcodes WordPress.com can’t run
fields.content:
These come from plugins the site doesn’t have, so they stay as text.

[vc_row][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_column_text]WPBakery: text in a column.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”142″ img_size=”medium”][/vc_column][/vc_row]

[et_pb_section fb_built=”1″][et_pb_row][et_pb_column type=”4_4″][et_pb_text]Divi: text in a section.[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_url=”https://example.com” button_text=”A Divi button”][/et_pb_button][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

[su_dropcap size=”5″]S[/su_dropcap]hortcodes Ultimate: a drop cap starts this sentence.

[infobox bg=”redlight” color=”black” opacity=”on” subtitle=”An infobox subtitle”]The infobox’s text.[/infobox]

[one_half]The first half.[/one_half][one_half_last]The second half.[/one_half_last]

[alert type=”warning”]An alert.[/alert]

[showhide title=”Show more”]Text to show.[/showhide]

[cbtabs][cbtab title=”One”]The first tab.[/cbtab][cbtab title=”Two”]The second tab.[/cbtab][/cbtabs]

[gigya src=”http://www.example.com/player.swf” width=”500″ height=”350″ allowFullScreen=”true”]

[gdrive url=”https://example.com/a-document.pdf”]

[wpzoom_rcb_post id=”1″]

[rt_reading_time label=”Reading time:” postfix=”minutes”]

Date: [time]Oct 21 2026 19:00 UTC[/time]

[stuck-order id=123]

[full_width]Full-width text.[/full_width]

A sentence with a reference.[ref]The reference.[/ref]

[rating stars=”4″]

The end.
